description:
Morning Gratitude Music | Indian Classical | 1.5 Hours

Start your morning here. Before the messages, the to-do list, the rush — give yourself ninety minutes of warm, uplifting Indian classical music to begin the day grateful and light.

What you'll hear: bright, shimmering santoor over a gentle pulse — sunny and open, the feeling of morning light filling a quiet room and a good mood settling in.

Best for: morning routines · journaling or gratitude practice · a slow coffee · easing into the day before anything is asked of you.

🔔 Subscribe to Raga Focus for Indian instrumental music to start your day grateful, calm, and bright.
thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate warm-gold patterned border. BRIGHT SUNRISE morning palette — warm golden light, soft dawn glow, hopeful and energizing (not dusky/evening). Central figure: a serene, content musician beginning the day with a santoor, upright and gently smiling, bathed in morning light — body language of a fresh, grateful start. IMPORTANT: vary the interior composition from the channel's other morning/Santoor thumbnails so it is visually distinct in-feed. Overlay text (A: 'WAKE UP GRATEFUL' / B: 'BEGIN WITH GRATITUDE') in dark-teal serif, large and mobile-readable (scans under 1 second). LIFESTYLE/outcome text — morning lane = lifestyle wins, NEVER a Q-hook. The distinctive Indian-miniature style is cultural authority that intrigues T1 wellness viewers — keep it. Mobile-first: minimal clutter.
suno_prompt_A: Uplifting Indian classical instrumental, Raga Bhupali — joyful pentatonic, bright positive and light, the warm feeling of waking up grateful to a new day, hammered santoor dulcimer with bright shimmering percussive attack and warm resonant sustain, gentle light tabla keeping an easy morning pulse, soft tanpura drone, 432Hz, 80 BPM, bright mid-high register, warm sunny open production, seamless loop-friendly texture, like morning light filling a quiet room, hopeful and grateful, no vocals, no humming, no human voice
suno_prompt_B: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming, uplifting Indian classical santoor, Raga Bhupali — joyful pentatonic bright and light, hammered santoor with bright shimmering attack and warm resonant sustain, gentle light tabla easy pulse, soft tanpura drone, 432Hz, 80 BPM, bright mid-high register, warm sunny open, seamless loop, like morning light filling a quiet room, hopeful and grateful

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Uplifting morning — bright and positive, NOT slow/sleepy. Santoor = hammered dulcimer (bright shimmering attack + warm sustain). LIGHT tabla OK (Santoor uplifting tolerates it). Alpha 10Hz (awake, present). Bhupali = joyful pentatonic. 80 BPM = upbeat-but-calm. PRESENT-NOT-DEAD OPENING: render the video to open on the brightest/most inviting phrase. Keep it sunny and warm — if a clip sounds melancholic or dim, regenerate (Bhupali should feel hopeful).

experiment_notes: TWO things on this ship: (1) MORNING SPREAD — week was evening-heavy (Mon wind-down, Tue mental fatigue, Wed tension, Fri heartache); this adds a morning lane. (2) T1-SEEDING EXPERIMENT — publish ~5pm IST (US morning) + T1-framed gratitude title to test whether timing + framing tilts the audience pool toward T1 (higher value). Measure T1 share at day 7: >30% = lever works (repeatable), <20% = content-gravity won. Honest expectation: a tilt (25-35%), not a flip. Single title (clean T1-share read) + thumb A/B (WAKE UP GRATEFUL vs RISE & SHINE, both lifestyle = within-format test). Morning Ritual dropped (VidIQ 27 dead). Cooldown Santoor 5d clear (last Jun 13). Reshuffle: Sarangi heartache moved Thu->Fri (replaces the broken Dilruba Overthinking).
